text: Surveyor Hansen is a Forsaken quest giver located at north of the Forgotten Shore in the Dragonblight. He seeks to expand the Forsaken town of Venomspite to shore and enlists Horde adventurers to kill Forgotten ghosts slain. He plans on naming the bay after himself or the adventure who helped him.
Surveyor Orlond is a level 73 dwarf quest giver located in the Grizzly Hills.
Swamp Spirits are bog beasts summoned by Swamp Talker in Stagalbog Cave of Swamp of Sorrows.
The Surgeon's Needle drops from Forgemaster Garfrost in the heroic version of the Pit of Saron.

Supreme Defender is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing 100 flag carriers in the Warsong Gulch battleground. This achievement is also criteria for the meta-achievement Master of Warsong Gulch.
The Surveyor's Beacon is provided as an objective for Survey the Lakeshore. When used, a Goblin Surveyor Jr. Grade will be called in to help mapping the Lake Mennar area.

Surplus Supplies were automatically awarded for being near a Barrens Caravan or a Pack Kodo at the end of its route in the Northern Barrens after (ostensibly) defending it from Kor'kron Caravan Raiders. See the caravan and kodo articles for information on routes.

Survivor's Bag of Coins is provided by Orsur, a ghost in Ravenholdt Manor. Only rogues may acquire it. Detection must be used in order to interact with Orsur. He will only give you the bag if you are disguised as Reislek's Ghost. Reislek's Ghost is found on a hilltop just south of the Manor, and you can disguise yourself by pickpocketing him while using the Glyph of Disguise.

Swallow Your Pride is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Sha of Pride in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance after no player has gained Pride from Manifestations of Pride while Norushen is alive.
Svarnos' Cell is the name of the cell within the D-Block of Tol Barad, found at the end of the hall towards the east. It's here Svarnos is held.

The Survivalist's Cache is found at on a cliff above Colossal's Fall just west of Magnarok in northeastern Frostfire Ridge. To access it, run to the north side of the Gate of the Breakers, where Broodmother Reeg'ak is found in her den. A good starting spot is on top of the path cave mouth. Run up the hill to the north-northwest, looking for the Rappelling Anchor at on a snow-covered ledge, with a non-active rope leading down to a small ledge. Jump down to the ledge and follow it to the northeast. At the very end of the ledge, nestled up against the cliff face, find the Survivalist's Cache between some small rocks. It contains 20-30 Garrison Resources.

The Sveldrek are a group of vrykul that invaded the Pit of Saron during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth. They got hold of Rimefang's harness that has also become an objective of the Knights of the Ebon Blade. They used it to subjugate frost wyrms. The new Deathlord and Minerva Ravensorrow entered the Pit, attacked the vrykul and raised several of them into the service of the Lich King. Ultimately, the death knights defeated their leader, Andjor Dragontamer, taking the harness with them.

Swiftmane is an elite rare mob zhevra found just above Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. As his name implies, he runs at ridiculously fast speeds. He can easily outrun a normal ground mount and stand up against an Epic one, so for those with not epic land mounts, you just have to wait until he comes back from his tour around the prairie. It's rumored that the reason Swiftmane runs around Northern Barrens like a rabid chicken is because of something horrible the zhevra witnessed Zonya the Sadist doing to the other animals in the area. __NOTOC__

At some point, Engineer Helice has been captured near the center of the dig and Hemet Nesingwary offered a hefty reward for her safe escort. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the Venture Company still continue their operations at the Suntouched Pillar. Swift Zhevra was originally the first special mount that players could earn only through the Recruit-A-Friend program. Prior to April 27, 2010, it was possible to earn this mount as a reward bonus of the Recruit-A-Friend system, once the recruit had bought World of Warcraft and 60 days of playtime. This reward bonus was then replaced by the X-53 Touring Rocket. In patch 5.4.1, the Recruit-A-Friend program was updated to include a choice of one mount from all current and previous Recruit-A-Friend mounts, and one companion from Asian-only promotions.

Swiftgear Station is an outpost located in the northwest section of the Wetlands, within Sundown Marsh. Prior to the Cataclysm it was just a small plot of farmland with a windmill and Fradd Swiftgear, and Wenna Silkbeard inside the dwarven building. Since then, Fradd built up the place into an outpost and it was named after him. Shilah Slabchisel is in charge of making sure that the place is safe enough for more settlement to start occurring.
